name: Brother Cobb
appearance: A lay brother in his fifties, short and wide through the chest, with forearms like a drover's and a leather apron black at the belly; a square weathered face gone red at the cheeks, soot in the creases, a nose flattened long ago, pale blue-grey eyes under heavy brows, grey stubble on the jaw, and short hair cropped close and going grey. Burn scars pale and shiny on both hands, and across the back of the right a half-ring of small white marks he calls a burn. He wears the House's grey hood pushed back and his sleeves past the elbow in any weather, and smells of coal and hoof-oil though nothing has worn a shoe up here in his time.
portrait_alt: Portrait of Brother Cobb: a broad, weathered man in his fifties with short grey hair, grey stubble, a flattened reddened nose and pale blue-grey eyes, soot on his face, in a grey hooded tunic with the hood down and a scorched leather apron, a forge fire glowing in a stone wall behind him.
last_seen_doing: Sat on a keg in the forge door taking the inside of Hollis's leather cup down a shaving at a time; told the Captain he was in his light and gave his name, Cobb; showed him the half-ring of marks on his right hand and called it a burn from a bar taken out of the fire forty years back; said he made Hollis's beech leg in a week off a tracing on sacking because the Mender would not wait, and that a cup is made to the stump and Hollis will not come down to be measured; named the Ninth's brand, the gate, and said he held the branding iron at the fair for twenty years before the mountain and chalks the lance brands up still because a hand forgets; tossed the cup to the Captain and sent him up to Hollis with it.
now: At his forge below the cloister with the next piece of leather, the fire banked to a red eye. He has sent the Captain up to Hollis with the remade cup and wants the word of where it bites brought back to him.

known_facts.fact: He says he has never been bitten by anything in his life, and that the half-ring of marks on his right hand is a burn from a bar taken out of the fire with the wrong hand forty years back.
known_facts.evidence: "Took a bar out of the fire with the wrong hand. Forty years back."

known_facts.fact: He made Hollis's beech leg in a week off a tracing on a bit of sacking, because the Mender said Hollis would not wait.
known_facts.evidence: I made that leg in a week off a tracing on a bit of sacking, because the Mender said he'd not wait.

known_facts.fact: He says a cup is not made once but made to the stump, which changes, and Hollis will not come down to him to have it fitted.
known_facts.evidence: A cup's not made once. It's made to the stump, and the stump changes, and he'll not come down to me.

known_facts.fact: He held the branding iron at the fair for twenty years before the mountain, burning the lances' brands onto Edgemoor greys, and keeps the brands chalked on a board by the forge door because a hand forgets.
known_facts.evidence: I held the iron twenty years before the mountain.

known_facts.fact: His forge shoes nothing; it holds laths stacked by length, a drum's tooth on the anvil, and a row of bell clappers from the size of a thumb to the size of a forearm.
known_facts.evidence: Nothing in the place had the shape of a horseshoe.

known_facts.fact: He sent the Captain up to Hollis with the remade cup: ten steps, not nine, and the word of where it bites to come back to him.
known_facts.evidence: "Take it up to him. He puts it on, he stands, he takes ten steps, not nine"

known_facts.fact: He says a man going up to the hall with his hands full is better than one coming down with them empty.
known_facts.evidence: "You're a man going up to the hall with his hands full."

relationships.label: made his leg
relationships.note: He turned the beech leg in a week off a tracing on sacking and is remaking its leather cup to the stump, which Hollis will not come down to have measured.
